name: Distributed Batched Rendering Loop
definition: A distributed rendering pipeline that processes camera views in batches, divides workload across multiple GPUs, preprocesses 3D Gaussian Splatting data, performs all-to-all communication, renders, and aggregates results across ranks.
summary: The Distributed Batched Rendering Loop is a parallelized 3D Gaussian Splatting pipeline that partitions Gaussians across GPUs and uses dynamic load balancing with sparse all-to-all communication to solve memory bottlenecks.
